title: Avro Lancaster R5489
memorial_details: description: In Memory of / Sgt, David Pullinger (Bomb Aimer) R.N.Z.A.F. and / Sgt. Jack Fletcher ( Flight Engineer) R.A.F.) who perished when / Lancaster R5489, KM-G of 44 (Rhodesia) Sqdn Waddington / crashed at Branston at 19 - 15 hrs on Sunday, 16th August, 1942 / "For your Tomorrows, they gave their Today" / "At the going down of the sun, and in the morning / we will remember them." /Made and presented by Frank Walshaw (Wireless Operator) / a survivor of the crash.
